question: ______ helps to maintain potential difference across a conductor.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Battery'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Battery**__ helps to maintain potential difference across a conductor.
 
• **Potential difference** is measured in volts (**V** )and is also known as **voltage**.
 
• It is also defined as **the amount of work,** that has been done in moving **a unit charge** from one point to another.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **A plug key** is an electrical component that **acts as a switch**. To turn on the circuit, a little metallic key is put into a metallic base, and the circuit is shut off if it is detached from its base.
 
• **Resistance** is **a measure of the opposition to current flow in an electrical circuit**. Resistance is measured in ohms, symbolized by the Greek letter omega (Ω).
 
• **A voltmeter** is a device that **measures voltages of direct current or alternating current **on a scale commonly in volts, millivolts, or kilovolts. Many voltmeters are digital that give readings as numerical displays.
